title: docs(spec): correct the Virtual ObjectQL retirement wording (context arms, readonly-writes docblock, ledger row)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB2JfLyoXowwaMTotLmArPu2)_

Fixes #27346

## What changes

The three prose should-fixes from contract review 6485025305 on the merged #27324 (#27028):

1. `packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.ts`, the `strictReadonlyWrites` docblock: no longer says the option does not "cross the RPC / Virtual Data Engine boundary" (that boundary is retired). It now says, as the `WriteObservabilityOptions` docblock already does, that nothing here can be serialized and none of it is reachable from a REST/wire body.
2. The D3 reason of `data-engine-rpc-protocol-retired` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.data-engine-rpc-protocol-retired.ts`): "every arm admitted a caller-supplied `context`" becomes "every read and write arm …". The `execute` arm carried an untyped options record and `vectorFind` had no `context`. The same sentence in the retirement comment in `packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts` gets the same correction.
3. `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.md`, the `data-engine.zod.ts` row note: records that ten more sites (`DataEngineRequestSchema` and its nine arms) left with #27028.

The pending `.changeset/27028-data-engine-rpc-protocol-retired.md` is **not** edited (check-empty-changeset). A new `.changeset/27346-data-engine-rpc-retirement-wording.md` (`@objectstack/spec` patch) carries a "Supersedes, in the same release:" paragraph naming that note's sentence and giving the corrected wording. Generated outputs the D3 reason feeds are regenerated where they move.

## Why

The released wording overstated the claim (two of the nine arms had no `context` key) and the docblock pointed at a boundary that no longer exists in the spec. Prose only: no schema, export or runtime behaviour changes.

## Verification

Readings are posted on the PR once the local runs finish (spec build, `check:generated`, spec `test:repo`, spec test under os-verify-lock, derived gates).
